data.title: Meowcademy
data.description: A modern tuition centre website for Meowcademy — a Singapore-based small group learning platform offering affordable, high-quality education for children aged 6 to 16 across all levels and subjects.
highlights: Course listings across Pre-K, Primary, and Secondary levels
Trial offer showcase — 4 lessons with no registration fee
Flexible payment plans via Atome, GrabPay, and bank instalments
Robotics and LEGO Spike Prime programme highlight
Multiple location listings and easy contact/enquiry flow
